question: A, B, C, D, W, X and Y are sitting around a circular table facing the centre of the table. A sits third to the left of X. Only one person sits between X and C when counted from the left of C. Only two people sit between B and W when counted from the right of W. D is an immediate neighbour of B. Who sits third to the right of Y?
solution:
**Given:** A, B, C, D, W, X and Y are sitting around a circular table facing the centre of the table.

1. A sits third to the left of X.

2. Only one person sits between X and C when counted from the left of C.

3. Only two people sit between B and W when counted from the right of W.

4. D is an immediate neighbour of B.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/76091b02afeaa065963e278
97d0efd52b210cc1d553a16d1753943fbd0b56f26.png] 

Thus, A sits third to the right of Y.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 2".
